facts.fact: On 23 January 2026 Prime Minister Ouedraogo said he had given clear instructions to repatriate all public administration platforms and data hosted in private data centres or abroad to national territory, under a "zero data abroad" goal, as two state modular data centres were inaugurated.

systems.system: Two modular government data centres (3,000 TB, sites about 100 km apart)
systems.tiers: state use; not stated for hire
